description: Candidate KOKUEN v5 universal component contracts. Promote a record to stable only after code, Figma, and fixture proof are complete.

components.userJob: Commit one clearly named action.

boundary.job: input affordance for primary/destructive; state only for quiet
boundary.rationale: One target edge communicates action ownership; quiet actions omit a resting edge.
boundary.widthBehavior: content by default; full row only for a documented narrow or task-wide action

accessibility.name: visible outcome label or explicit accessible name
accessibility.description: consequence or shortcut only when needed
accessibility.errorRelationship: failure message associated with affected region

keyboard.focusReturn: remains unless an opened layer defines return

behavior.loading: keeps outcome label and exposes busy state

content.overflow: no silent truncation of the action outcome

responsive.reflow: content width unless the task requires full width

components.userJob: Invoke a familiar compact action without losing target size or meaning.

boundary.rationale: The mark is bare at rest; target and focus geometry provide interaction state.
boundary.restingOwner: none for quiet; button for destructive when required
boundary.widthBehavior: fixed 44px target

accessibility.name: explicit accessible action name
accessibility.description: tooltip supplements but never names alone

responsive.reflow: stays with the object it affects

components.userJob: Enter or edit a single-line value with clear label, help, and recovery.

boundary.rationale: The input or composite shell owns one field edge; child controls never add another resting bezel.
boundary.restingOwner: input for plain field; shell for composite
boundary.focusOwner: same owner through focus-visible or focus-within
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded by expected value; full row only for search or true full-row entry

keys: Escape only for a documented clear or search policy
keyboard.focusReturn: field action returns focus to field when it changes the value

behavior.pointer: click positions caret; label focuses field

content.localization: label and recovery wrap; IME preserved
content.overflow: value scrolls natively; essential label is not clipped

responsive.reflow: proximal action remains attached at narrow width and zoom

components.userJob: Compose and edit multiline content.

boundary.rationale: One textarea edge contains the multiline editing region.
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded or composition width based on task

accessibility.name: programmatic visible label
accessibility.description: hint, count, and error as applicable

keys: Tab policy documented for code editors

content.overflow: grows or scrolls without clipping focus or text

responsive.reflow: fills bounded composition region

components.userJob: Select zero or more independent options.

boundary.rationale: The small mark depicts value while focus surrounds the whole labelled target.
boundary.widthBehavior: content with wrapping label

keys: Enter for button-based implementation when platform-consistent

responsive.reflow: description stays attached

components.userJob: Choose exactly one option from a labelled set.

boundary.rationale: Each radio mark depicts value; no container bezel is added around the group.
boundary.widthBehavior: content; vertical at narrow width

accessibility.name: group legend and option labels
accessibility.state: one checked item and disabled options

keyboard.focusEntry: Tab enters checked or first enabled radio
keyboard.focusReturn: roving focus remains on selected option

responsive.reflow: inline group becomes vertical before crowding

components.userJob: Change an immediate binary setting.

boundary.rationale: Track and thumb form one mark; focus surrounds the whole labelled target.
boundary.widthBehavior: content

behavior.repeatActivation: blocked while persistence is pending when ordering matters

content.limits: setting name does not change with value

responsive.reflow: status stays with setting

components.userJob: Choose a value along a bounded range.

boundary.job: input affordance for range and current value
boundary.rationale: Track and thumb communicate one control; focus follows the full track target.
boundary.restingOwner: track and thumb as one mark
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded by precision and layout

accessibility.name: visible label
accessibility.state: min, max, now, text, orientation, disabled

behavior.pointer: whole track sets or drags value

responsive.reflow: value may move below track

components.userJob: Choose one value from a temporary option list.

boundary.job: input affordance, list containment, and focus state
boundary.rationale: Trigger owns one field edge; listbox owns one temporary-layer edge.
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded by expected option; list matches trigger unless content requires documented expansion

accessibility.name: visible label
accessibility.state: expanded, controls, active descendant, selected, disabled, invalid

keyboard.focusExit: Tab after commit or documented close
keyboard.focusReturn: DOM focus remains on trigger in active-descendant model

content.localization: long values wrap or use documented full-value path
content.overflow: list scrolls with reachable active option

responsive.reflow: list collision and viewport height handled

components.userJob: Switch among peer panels without navigating away.

boundary.rationale: Spacing and type establish the group; no outer navigation bezel is required.
boundary.widthBehavior: content; scrolls or reflows before targets shrink

keyboard.focusReturn: roving focus remains on active tab

content.localization: scroll or reflow for long labels

responsive.reflow: horizontal scroll or alternate navigation

components.userJob: Choose a temporary contextual action.

boundary.rationale: The menu surface owns one layer edge; items use state tone rather than nested boxes.
boundary.restingOwner: trigger as its own action; menu surface when open
boundary.widthBehavior: content with minimum readable measure and viewport collision handling

keyboard.focusEntry: trigger opens to documented first or last item

behavior.pointer: trigger opens; outside closes; item invokes
behavior.loading: menu closes to stable progress surface

responsive.reflow: collision flips or becomes documented sheet

components.userJob: Scan and invoke one item while retaining secondary metadata and actions.

boundary.job: separation only when peer rows would merge
boundary.rationale: Rows use alignment and spacing first; an optional shared rule supports scanning.
boundary.widthBehavior: container width with stable internal columns

accessibility.role: listitem with link/button, or option for a real selection model
accessibility.name: primary label

keys: composite keys only for a documented listbox

behavior.pointer: one clear primary target; no nested button

content.localization: long labels wrap or expose full value

responsive.reflow: metadata stacks before primary label is squeezed

components.userJob: Compare structured values across rows and columns.

boundary.job: column and row separation for comparison
boundary.rationale: Table rules support scanning; cells are not individually boxed.
boundary.widthBehavior: content table with horizontal scroll or alternate representation before squeezing

keys: Enter/Space on sort and row controls
keyboard.focusReturn: stable after sort; next logical row after deletion

behavior.pointer: headers and row actions have explicit targets
behavior.repeatActivation: sort and actions follow their own contracts

content.overflow: scroll or alternate labelled rows; no anonymous hidden columns

responsive.density: data spacing may compact; controls do not
responsive.reflow: priority columns, scroll, or labelled rows documented

components.userJob: Move through a bounded result set while knowing the current page.

boundary.rationale: Each page target has one focus geometry; current state does not require every target to be boxed.
boundary.restingOwner: current page or target only when needed
boundary.widthBehavior: content with compact range

keyboard.focusReturn: documented result heading or retained control

content.overflow: range shortens rather than targets shrink

responsive.reflow: page range reduces

components.userJob: Read supplementary explanation for an already named control.

boundary.rationale: One compact surface separates supplementary text from the page.
boundary.widthBehavior: short readable measure with collision handling

behavior.pointer: opens on hover delay and remains while hovered when needed
behavior.touch: not the only access to meaning

responsive.reflow: placement flips

components.userJob: Interact with contextual nonmodal content anchored to a control.

boundary.rationale: One anchored surface separates nonmodal work; child controls own their own focus only.
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded by content and viewport collision

accessibility.role: region or dialog according to content
accessibility.name: visible label when required

content.limits: contextual content, not a hidden page
content.overflow: internal scroll only with visible close

responsive.reflow: may become documented sheet

components.userJob: Complete a focused modal task without background interaction.

boundary.rationale: One dialog surface plus scrim establishes the modal layer; no nested shell.
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded by task with viewport gutters and height-safe scrolling

keyboard.focusEntry: least destructive useful control, first field, or dialog container
keyboard.focusReturn: opener or nearest logical surviving control

behavior.pointer: background blocked; outside close policy explicit
behavior.loading: task remains labelled and cancel policy visible

content.overflow: internal content scroll keeps title and close reachable

responsive.reflow: near-full viewport with gutters on narrow screens

components.userJob: Confirm or cancel a costly, external, or irreversible consequence.

boundary.rationale: Uses the dialog boundary; action styling does not add another container.
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded readable measure

accessibility.role: alertdialog only when immediate attention is required; otherwise dialog
accessibility.name: exact consequence title

responsive.reflow: actions may stack without reversing safe order

components.userJob: Receive a nonblocking outcome or recovery notice.

boundary.rationale: One compact surface separates feedback; internal text and action are not carded again.
boundary.widthBehavior: bounded readable measure within viewport gutter

accessibility.role: status for polite or alert for urgent
accessibility.name: outcome text
accessibility.errorRelationship: not a replacement for persistent field error

keyboard.focusExit: normal Tab order when action exists

behavior.pointer: pause timeout on hover; action works

responsive.reflow: uses viewport gutter

components.userJob: Understand why content is absent, pending, failed, stale, or unavailable and recover when possible.

boundary.job: none by default; state only when affected region needs a boundary
boundary.rationale: Spacing and language communicate state without an empty card or icon tile.
boundary.widthBehavior: matches affected content region

accessibility.role: status or alert based on urgency
accessibility.name: state text

responsive.reflow: matches region

components.userJob: Navigate, search, create, or run a bounded action from one keyboard-first surface.

boundary.job: modal command containment and input affordance
boundary.rationale: One command surface contains one input and list; the input uses a single focus edge without nested search bezel.
boundary.restingOwner: trigger when closed; command surface and input when open
boundary.widthBehavior: viewport service bounded by command maximum and gutters

accessibility.name: dialog and input labels plus option names
accessibility.state: expanded, controls, active descendant, selected, busy, unavailable

keyboard.focusExit: modal focus trap until close or navigation

behavior.loading: stale results not presented as current
behavior.repeatActivation: invoke once and expose stable progress

content.limits: direct result labels with scope metadata
content.localization: long and CJK results preserve active row
content.overflow: list scroll keeps active option visible

responsive.reflow: near-full viewport with safe height

components.userJob: Provide multiline intent, scope, and attachments, then send or stop work.

boundary.rationale: One composition surface contains text and proximal actions; buttons keep separate focus without extra resting shells.
boundary.focusOwner: focused textarea or action within one composite
boundary.widthBehavior: working width of the AI task

accessibility.role: textbox plus named buttons and status
accessibility.name: prompt label and action names

keyboard.focusReturn: textarea after removable attachment or recoverable error

behavior.loading: Send becomes stable Stop according to operation state

content.limits: multiline prompt and real attachment names
content.overflow: composer grows then scrolls without hiding actions

responsive.reflow: scope and attachments wrap within composer

components.userJob: Read, stop, verify, copy, and recover a generated result with clear provenance.

boundary.job: none by default; containment only when output is one movable or independently scrolling object
boundary.rationale: Type and spacing distinguish generated output; a card is not required around every response.
boundary.restingOwner: response region only when containment has a job
boundary.widthBehavior: readable text measure inside work region

accessibility.name: generated response label when context requires
accessibility.errorRelationship: failure and retry remain with response

keys: Tab to Stop, sources, copy, retry, and approval actions
keyboard.focusReturn: Stop returns to response status; approval follows dialog contract

behavior.repeatActivation: Stop and Retry idempotent or blocked

content.limits: clearly authored output with source proximity
content.localization: mixed script and long source titles
content.overflow: code/data gets deliberate scroll; prose wraps

responsive.reflow: sources and actions stack without leaving output
